svg.title: Lutherverse
svg.desc: Concept title card. The pixel wordmark LUTHERVERSE over a violet void, with the subtitle "a cosmic-horror roguelike descent". At left, a square stair winds inward: floors 001 to 025 are lit, the rest of the way to floor 200 is dark, and at its centre a small keyhole glows gold. A dotted ward-light border runs round the edge, with gaps in one corner.
